topic.title: Translator Helper Add-on
topic.shortdesc: The Translator Helper add-on helps translators create preliminary translations for XML content and view the original content side by side while editing.

body.note:
This add-on is compatible with the following products:
Oxygen XML Editor
Oxygen XML Author
body.p: offers an add-on that provides support for helping translators. Once the add-on is installed, you can use Google Translate to create a preliminary translation for your XML content that can later be manually improved. The add-on is also useful for showing potential customers how a DITA project will look like after it is translated into their native language. After the add-on is installed, a Translator Helper view is available from the Window Show View menu.
